subtitle: Proper Tigrinya Ge'ez Keyboard
creator: Antonyo S MICHAEL
promotionalText: BELA ቤላ — the proper Tigrinya keyboard. Type fluently in Ge'ez script, switch languages instantly, and personalize with beautiful themes.
description:
BELA ቤላ Keyboard is a beautifully crafted native Tigrinya and Ge'ez keyboard for iPhone, created by Antonyo S MICHAEL.

FEATURES
• Full Ethiopic syllabary — 33 base consonants with a single-tap vowel popup for all 7 forms
• Tigrinya word suggestions as you type
• Three languages in one — Tigrinya, Tigre, Amharic
• Eight beautiful themes including Habesha, Eritrea, Ocean, Forest, Night and more
• Numbers, Latin and Ge'ez modes — switch with one tap
• Native iOS performance, no ads in the keyboard, fully private
• Optimized for iPhone, light and dark mode

Premium Themes unlock 5 extra themes with a one-time in-app purchase.

Need help or want to suggest a feature? Email support@belakeyboard.app
reviewNotes: Enable the keyboard under Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards > Add New Keyboard > Bela Keyboard. Premium themes unlock via in-app purchase (StoreKit testing supported with Configuration.storekit). No 'Full Access' is required for v1 — the keyboard performs no network requests.
